_doc: Idle thread and wakeup budget per process kind (scripts/cmux-next/idle-budget.py; plans/cmux-next/idle-wakeups.md section 9). Idle: no input, no visible change, terminals quiet, after the settle. Fields: wakeups_per_s and cpu_pct are the sum over the kind's processes; wakeups_max and threads_max are per process; main_wakes_per_s is the app's main run loop. A value may be one number or {session: number}. null: measured and reported, not judged yet (thread caps are set from the first measurement after the fixes). Proposed by PL-idle 2026-10-24 with the Performance Lead: app main thread 0, app <= 1/s, daemon <= 1/s, holder 0.
_doc_d15: D15 (plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p14-energy.md, task p14-energy-105): after the settle, in every idle session, every kind writes 0 disk bytes (disk_bytes_per_s, ri_diskio_byteswritten), 0 unified-log lines (log_lines, `log show` of the pid set) and 0 network bytes (network_bytes, nettop, lo0 included) unless an allowed_periodic entry names the kind and metric. all_kinds applies to every measured kind under its own limits. connections and WindowServer wakeups are reported, not judged. allowed_periodic: [{owner, period_s, why, kind, metrics: [field], remote (optional: every remote end of the kind contains it)}], period_s >= 15, a named owner.
